'''Soproni VSE''' is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] football club based in [[Sopron]], Győr-Moson-Sopron, Hungary, that competes in the [[Megyei Bajnokság I]], the fourth tier of [[Hungarian football league system|Hungarian football]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.svse.hu |title=SVSE |publisher=Svse.hu |access-date=2023-07-26}}</ref> The club's colours are [[purple]] and [[white]]. They won the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] two times in 1945 and 1946, but they have never played in the first league. In 2011, the club won the championship in the third league, so in the 2011–12 season they were promoted to the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]]. It is a successor of [[FC Sopron]]."}}
